It will have two lanes up to 1.8 km, and four lanes for the remaining stretch. The project will take 2 years to complete

content: Justice D. Bharatha Chakravarthy of the Madras High Court recently said that it was for Parliament to consider whether involving children in campaigning should be made a ground for setting aside the election of candidates

content: The court also cancelled his bail and directed him to surrender before the trial court to serve the sentence

content: The film will be screened at 6 p.m. on October 24 and at 11 a.m. on October 25. Entry is free and seating will be available on a first-come, first-served basis, the statement said.

content: Health Minister U.T. Khader says no hospital should deny families the bodies of deceased patients; government to examine complaints of excessive billing

content: “It is a matter of joy that, through the efforts of Central and State governments and their own willpower, Chhattisgarh’s youth are freeing themselves from the misguided path of Maoism,” says the President

title: The real crisis in India’s fisheries
content: Official claims that most of India’s marine fish stocks are sustainable should not distract from the continuing degradation of the country’s inshore fishing grounds; stronger governance of coastal waters and better management of mechanised trawling are essential for truly sustainable fisheries

title: Why managing fiscal is a tightrope for State governments
content: Most State government expenditure is on social sectors, such as health and education, and economic sectors, such as agriculture and irrigation. In Kerala, such spending has driven social progress since the 1960s. The gap between expenditure and receipts is usually financed through market borrowings.

title: Cabinet Secretary had copied acknowledgement sent to letters by two ECs to CEC for ‘information’: RTI reply

content: Since ‘the registered madrasas have been reclassified as schools, hence the institutions required to follow the guidelines issued by the education department and the authority,’ an official from the department said.

content: The Regional Meteorological Centre has issued orange and yellow alerts warning of heavy to very heavy rainfall in several districts.  The prospects of rain spell continuing in the State next week hinge on the low pressure area expected to develop in the Bay of Bengal on Friday

title: Government had warm ties with outgoing Governor Arlekar, says Keralam Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan
content: Attending his official send-off, Arlekar says he only returned the affection shown by people of the State; he adds that he is happy that he could complete his tenure without much confrontation

title: Six dead, 40 injured as bus hits tree in Chhattisgarh; CM announces compensation
content: Chief Minister Vishnu Deo Sai announced financial assistance of ₹5 lakh each to the kin of the deceased and ₹50,000 each to the injured

title: Telangana to host three-day Raksha Expo from December 7
content: The inaugural edition of the State-level expo for aerospace, space, defence and internal security sectors will coincide with the Invest Telangana Global Summit 2026 at the Bharat Future City, near Hyderabad

title: 3 aircraft carriers, jets & troops: Israel, US plan to attack Iran after midterms
content: The United States and Israel are preparing for potential military strikes against Iran after the upcoming midterm elections. Iran has announced it will reveal a new weapon called the 'Father of All Bombs' as tensions rise. US Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth met Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to discuss military options recently. Meanwhile, Iranian officials warn of severe responses if attacked, emphasizing improved missile capabilities.

title: PM Modi calls for stronger global institutions; takes ‘failed product’ jab at Cong
content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi emphasized the need for stronger global institutions during his address at the NDTV World Summit. He argued that the current global system struggles to address new challenges, particularly in international relations. Modi also criticized Congress leadership for failing to effectively launch their leader, calling it a burden on the party. Furthermore, he highlighted India's role in international cooperation, especially during the Covid-19 pandemic.

title: Civil war & terror: Why Libya is still broken 15 yrs after Gaddafi's bloody end
content: Since the fall of Muammar Gaddafi in 2011, Libya has been trapped in a cycle of political strife and disunity. Although a UN-backed agreement was reached with hopes of conducting elections, various administrations maintain control over separate regions. By April 2026, a unified national budget was achieved, yet obstacles to effective implementation loom large.

title: BrahMos goes global, eyes next-gen missile by 2028; 1,500-km strike variant on radar
content: BrahMos Aerospace is set to develop the next-generation BrahMos-NG missile by 2027-28. The company aims to strengthen its supply chain and production capacity to meet increasing demand. Interest from foreign militaries in air-launched versions of BrahMos is growing. A 1,500-km-range variant is also under exploration but remains at a conceptual stage. Recent contracts with the Indian Navy are expected to boost domestic manufacturing and participation from local industries.

title: After renaming Lake Ontario, Google CEO rejects US request to rename Atlantic Ocean
content: President Trump has recently proposed renaming the Atlantic Ocean, following prior discussions about the Atlantic Ocean. During a recent event, he mentioned contacting Google Maps regarding these renaming efforts. Google CEO Sundar Pichai reportedly declined his proposal on the grounds that oceans encompass multiple countries. This follows the US administration's earlier renaming of Lake Ontario to Lake America for US users.

title: 21 years on, double life term for Jammu terror attack that killed baby, 2 others
content: In his order on Wednesday, principal sessions judge Ramban Ajay Kumar Gupta rejected defence arguments that the attack had taken place more than two decades ago when Sharief was young, his long incarceration and possibility of rehabilitation. Besides the life sentences, the court imposed two separate terms of 10 years on Sharief under various sections pertaining to murder and arms act offences.

title: Florida owners sue over $13,157 roof fee; allege $232,000 paid before vote
content: Homeowners in The Vistas at Phillips Commons have initiated a lawsuit against their homeowners association. They allege that a roofing contract worth $2.1 million was approved secretly before an official vote. The residents claim that a significant deposit was made before the meeting took place, indicating potential financial misconduct. An active criminal investigation is examining alleged irregularities involving both the association and the management company.

title: Iran claims 7 oil tankers damaged in Hormuz, warns strikes if US helps passage
content: Seven oil tankers sustained damage in the Strait of Hormuz as a result of attacks and naval mines. Four of the tankers reportedly caught fire while transferring oil, creating significant challenges. Iranian authorities have warned of potential targeting of US bases if the situation escalates.

title: Phoenix office tower sold for $10.3m, set to become 100-room Marriott hotel
content: The iconic Ellis Building, erected in 1922, is set to undergo a transformation into a chic boutique hotel, managed by Aperture Hotels and affiliated with Marriott's Tribute Portfolio. This revitalization aims to breathe new life into the historic space, following previous redevelopment failures. The project promises about 95 to 105 stylish guest rooms, complemented by a modern restaurant and bar, aligning with similar projects in downtown Phoenix.

title: Vanessa Hudgens bought Gary Oldman's LA home for nearly $5m, sold for $6.7m
content: In 2018, Vanessa Hudgens acquired a charming historic residence in Los Angeles from Gary Oldman for almost $5 million. She renovated and redesigned the space, ultimately selling it to Ronan Farrow and Jon Lovett in February 2022 for an impressive $6.725 million. The 1922-built house, fondly known as Little DeMille, boasted rich heritage, beautiful gardens, and artistic enhancements by Hudgens, showcasing her flair for style.

title: Palantir exec to Europe: You need China for drones and US tech for now
content: Palantir Technologies highlights the necessary reliance on US technology for European countries in the short term. Louis Mosley addressed challenges, including Europe’s reliance on China for industrial components needed for defense capabilities. As European nations consider reducing foreign technology use, Palantir faces scrutiny from some countries like France and the UK. Nonetheless, Mosley noted strong engagement in markets like Ukraine, where practical needs take precedence.

title: Texas man put $12,000 down on 10 acres; glamping grosses over $100,000 yearly
content: Garrett Brown launched Cameron Ranch Glamping on a picturesque 10-acre plot in Houston, beginning with a minimal budget. He cleverly applied land hacking methods that streamlined utility connections while steering clear of complicated planning processes. The business flourished initially with a geodome, later evolving through zero-cost revenue-sharing arrangements. Rather than relying on third-party bookings, he focused on direct guest engagement, chronicling his experiences in his book, The Glamping Investor.

title: Giannis Antetokounmpo reportedly invested $70 million in real estate in 2025
content: Since October 2025, NBA superstar Giannis Antetokounmpo has strategically invested approximately $70 million in various real estate ventures. His family's company, Ante, has facilitated several significant purchases, including apartment complexes in Wisconsin, Brooklyn, and Chicago. Notably, he recently acquired a lavish $13.5 million mansion in Pinecrest, Florida, after joining the Miami Heat. These investments reflect Antetokounmpo's commitment to expanding his financial portfolio beyond basketball income.

title: Murray’s wife Kim Sears, four children: Inside his family life after retirement
content: Andy Murray has officially retired from professional tennis and, in doing so, has opened a new chapter in his life, and the former world No 1 will have more time to spend with his wife Kim Sears and their four children. From parenting and family routines to their shared business interests at Cromlix, the couple are handling life outside the demands of professional tennis while keeping family at the center.

title: What El Nino? This ground up farmers’ cooperative continues to reap dividends
content: Farmers in Mulkanoor village have established a cooperative that supports agricultural needs, improving self-reliance. This cooperative has recently partnered with HarvestLink to export branded rice to the US market. They expect their first shipment of rice to be dispatched within a month, pending regulations. The cooperative has a strong membership base and provides various support services to its members.

title: Michigan court upholds $85,000 and $91,250 awards in neighbours' water feud
content: A years-long dispute between neighbours in Michigan over flooding and water flowing across their properties resulted in both sides receiving compensation. A jury awarded $85,000 to William Michael Coan and Cindy Plant and $91,250 to Robert Ercolani. On October 20, 2026, the Michigan Court of Appeals upheld both awards and an independent drainage plan intended to address the flooding.

title: Georgia woman loses marijuana smoke case as court upholds pension fund immunity
content: A Georgia woman sued after claiming her neighbour’s marijuana smoke repeatedly entered her apartment despite a no-smoking lease, affecting her breathing and health. Bridget Francis alleged that the apartment management ignored her complaints. However, on October 19, 2026, a Georgia appeals court upheld the dismissal of her claims against a California teachers’ pension fund, ruling that it was legally protected from the lawsuit.

title: One frame at a time! Story of Multan's Minhas brothers through their father's lens
content: Kashif Minhas once gave up his own cricketing ambitions at his father's insistence. Today, the Multan-based businessman watches his sons Arafat and Sameer represent Pakistan, capturing their journeys through his lens while hoping they will fulfil his dream of winning an ICC trophy for the country.

title: Bengaluru horror: Man kills wife, steals motorcycle to dump body in drain Do
content: Mohammad Irfaj, a 22-year-old migrant labourer from Bihar, allegedly murdered his 25-year-old wife Ruksana over infidelity suspicions. The couple’s relationship had deteriorated, leading to frequent quarrels about her phone conversations. On October 10, Irfaj killed Ruksana with a stone and concealed her body in a stormwater drain. Police discovered her body three days later and identified her after public inquiries.

title: Indian diaspora could pay price for West’s immigration backlash, warns Sushant Sareen
content: As Trump blames France’s unrest on immigration and urges Macron to close borders, expert warns law-abiding Indians could get caught in the crossfire

title: Connecticut wool mill that lost 85 jobs now employs 50, makes military fabric
content: A Connecticut wool mill that closed in 2013, leaving 85 workers jobless, has been revived by former investment banker Jacob Harrison Long. He bought the 475,000-square-foot factory in 2014 despite having no manufacturing experience. Twelve years later, the mill employs about 50 people and supplies fabric for US military uniforms. Long now hopes to expand textile manufacturing across New England.

title: Newton's 1687 book on gravity, funded by Halley, sold for Rs 5.49 crore
content: In a significant auction event, a first edition of Isaac Newton's *Philosophiæ naturalis principia mathematica* garnered an impressive US$576,000. This pivotal work introduced revolutionary concepts of motion and gravity through mathematical frameworks. With ties to distinguished scholars like the Kennet family and the vital endorsement from Edmond Halley, Newton's insights continue to resonate in disciplines such as engineering and astronomy, shaping modern scientific thought.

title: Asian Para Games: Where India stands in medal tally after best day with 7 golds
content: India showcased an extraordinary performance at the Asian Para Games 2026, clinching 26 medals and securing a commendable fourth place overall. With a breathtaking total of 88 medals, including 21 gold, the day was especially memorable for armless archer Sheetal Devi, who bagged two golds in quick succession. Para-athletics was pivotal in this achievement, propelling India past South Korea in the medal standings.

title: Marine life on the brink? 96% of coral reefs could face collapse by 2075
content: The International Union for Conservation of Nature recently highlighted the alarming vulnerability of coral reefs, predicting that by 2075, nearly all shallow-water coral systems may collapse due to rising ocean temperatures. This impending crisis threatens not only marine biodiversity but also the local communities that depend on these ecosystems for their livelihoods.

title: Maldives begins planting coral on 2 submerged planes to build artificial reef
content: Two decommissioned Dornier 228 aircraft are submerged near Kudagiri Island to create a diving attraction. Conservation teams are working to establish an artificial reef by attaching coral fragments to underwater frames. The project aims to combine marine tourism with aviation history while promoting coral growth. Various organizations are collaborating to monitor the ecological impact of this initiative.

title: Florida couple missed 66 mortgage payments; man's bank lawsuit rejected
content: A Florida couple missed 66 monthly mortgage payments on their Naples property, triggering a foreclosure dispute that began in 2009. During the legal battle, Gregory Brian Myers agreed to deposit $5,000 monthly while appealing the foreclosure. He later sued U.S. Bank, alleging it had violated their agreement. On October 19, 2026, a federal appeals court upheld the dismissal of his lawsuit.

title: London duplex in building once home to Keira Knightley lists for £11.5m
content: After an extensive two-year renovation, the Hyde Park Gardens duplex in London stands elegantly restored. Spanning 4,071 square feet, the lavish residence boasts three bedrooms and bathrooms, complemented by a private terrace overlooking four acres of communal greens. Available for £11.5 million, it’s perfect for those craving luxury and convenience, with nearby attractions including Connaught Village and accessible transport at Lancaster Gate and Paddington stations.

title: IND vs NZ: Samson special helps India pull off highest successful chase in T20Is
content: Chasing 226, India got off to a flying start but lost their way in the middle overs before captain Shreyas Iyer and Naman Dhir helped them cross the finish line with two balls to spare.

title: 300 gamers raise $1m for cancer research after Oregon woman’s diagnosis
content: When Jessica Conwell confronted the daunting challenge of triple-negative breast cancer, her husband Matt leaned on his gaming community for support. This passionate group rallied together, spearheading fundraising activities that amassed a remarkable $55,000 in their inaugural event. Inspired by early success, they continued their efforts, ultimately raising over $1 million for critical cancer research.

title: France unrest: Macron vows ban on 'illegitimate' protests in coming days
content: In response to escalating unrest, French President Emmanuel Macron unveiled plans to prohibit unauthorized protests while ramping up security measures. Following extensive riots and vandalism, authorities brace for further gatherings this weekend. Trade unions and recognized groups will be directed to alternative protest paths to mitigate potential damage, with the initial disturbances rooted in student protests spurring broader demonstrations against rising living costs, just ahead of France's upcoming presidential election.

title: Joe Root creates history! Becomes 1st England batter to cross 8,000-run mark in ODIs
content: Joe Root achieved a significant milestone by becoming the first English batter to surpass 8,000 runs in ODIs. This achievement occurred during a match against Sri Lanka in the Pakistan ODI Tri-Series. Root scored 69 runs off 66 balls and has reached a career total of 8,005 runs in 197 matches. His records include 20 centuries and 49 half-centuries, highlighting his batting prowess.

title: Russia to review Trump invitation to Putin for G20 summit, possible talks on Ukraine
content: Russia is reviewing the invitation for President Vladimir Putin to attend the upcoming G20 summit in December. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov indicated that no final decision has been made yet. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced Putin's potential attendance could facilitate discussions with various world leaders. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy mentioned the possibility of a trilateral meeting involving Ukraine, Russia, and the United States.

title: Did strategic mistrust prompt Germany to pull out of Boeing's Ghost Bat deal
content: Germany has informed Boeing it will not buy the MQ-28 Ghost Bat drone as it adjusts its plans. The country is looking to acquire F-35 fighter jets while delaying its uncrewed combat aircraft program to early 2030s. Other companies are emerging as competitors, offering alternative drone solutions by 2029. This shift reflects ongoing discussions on military procurement and strategic autonomy amid increasing global security concerns.

title: Ralf Schumacher says Lewis Hamilton and Fernando Alonso block young F1 drivers
content: Ralf Schumacher highlighted the issues young drivers face in Formula 1 due to the prolonged careers of veteran racers. He noted that older drivers like Fernando Alonso and Lewis Hamilton are still competitive, which affects opportunities for rising stars. Schumacher stated that if veterans continue racing into their 40s, it may be necessary to reassess the relevance of Formula 2.

title: Frankfurt’s fitted kitchens turn 100; volunteers save parts from about 50
content: In the year 1926, Margarete Schütte-Lihotzky revolutionized domestic design by creating the Frankfurt Kitchen, aimed at maximizing cooking efficiency for urban dwellers. While around 10,000 of these iconic kitchens were initially integrated into Frankfurt residences, many have since succumbed to renovations. Today, preservationists are dedicated to conserving the remaining kitchens, adapting them with modern appliances while respecting their historical integrity.

title: Trump Asks Elon Musk To Lift Ukraine Starlink Restrictions: Reports
content: President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said earlier on Thursday that Starlink speed had not been restored for Ukraine, adding that he hoped for talks with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in the coming days.

title: Saudi Aramco Tells Staff To Evacuate Headquarters Amid Yemen Tensions: Report
content: Non-essential staff had been working remotely since the headquarters in eastern Saudi Arabia was hit last week.

title: Gurugram Plunges Into Darkness As Electricity Workers Go On Strike
content: The employees of DHBVN are striking against the government's decision to privatise the power distribution system in Gurugram and Nuh.

title: Trump's 'SIR' Gets Halted In 9 States As Judge Finds Errors In Probe
content: US District Court Judge in Oakland found the government's effort is relying on data that is full of errors and that it's leading to intimidation of groups performing voter assistance efforts. She said it should be halted until polls close on Election Day.

title: Houthis Claim They Rescued 14 Indians From Yacht, India Says Extending Help
content: The reported incident comes a day after an Indian national was killed in an attack on King Fahd International Airport in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. Another person was also killed, while two Indian nationals were injured.

title: Pregnant Teen Gang-Raped In Rajasthan, Baby Dies Soon After Delivery
content: The incident occurred in the Kolwa police station area, where the 16-year-old girl was found to be pregnant and subsequently delivered a baby who did not survive, according to the police.

content: Ashok Bhagabhai Thakor was lured to a farm shed, poisoned with spiked liquor, and strangled to death in a planned murder.

content: The victim has been identified as Sameer Ghosh (27), a BJP worker. His family have accused the opposition Trinamool Congress of the murder.

content: "What you have heard from Secretary Rubio, Secretary Piyush Goyal and others, I am also saying the same thing that we are moving towards this agreement".

title: Netanyahu's Hindi Invite To PM Modi For Israel's Independence Day
content: PM Modi travelled to Israel in February on his second visit to the country in nine years. The India-Israel relationship was elevated to the level of strategic partnership during his first visit to Tel Aviv in July 2017.

title: PM Modi Says 'Parasite' Congress Hurts 'Honest' Dissent Movements
content: "There are movements that naturally want to expose the government's shortcomings and genuinely want to reform the system, and this is necessary in a democracy... Their voice gets lost in Congress's noise," said PM Narendra Modi, as part of a keynote address at the NDTV World Summit 2026.

title: Gujarat's School Entry Rules Invoke Child Sexual Abuse Law Against Violators
content: The fresh circular mandates that any external individual must secure prior written authorisation from school principals before stepping onto campus grounds, recording video, or conducting interviews with students and teachers.

title: Judge Asks Trump To Depose In BBC Defamation Lawsuit By December 11
content: The order from US Magistrate Judge Enjolique Lett came as the BBC's lawyers complained that Trump had delayed his appearance. Attorney Charles Tobin said that with two months left in the discovery period, "we still haven't been able to depose the plaintiff."

title: "Some Dreaming Of Disorder": PM's "Failed Product Of Congress" Jibe At Rahul Gandhi
content: The Prime Minister said "dimagi Naxals" are dominating the Congress so much that it can't think for itself anymore.

title: Police Case Over Delhi Influencer's Racist Video Against Tripura Teen
content: Director General of Police GS Rao said Delhi Police had been extending cooperation to Tripura Police and would provide further assistance during the investigation.

title: RSS-Linked Group Opens Its First Public Office In Kashmir Valley
content: Sameer Kuchay, the Kashmir in-charge of the Bharatiya Mazdoor Sangh, says the Sangh has already covered lot of ground in the Valley before formally opening its first public office.

title: Earthquake of magnitude 7.0 hits Tibet
content:
A strong earthquake of magnitude 7.0 struck Tibet on Thursday, according to seismic data. The earthquake occurred at a depth of 173 kilometres. The most recent earthquake to strike Nepal was on September 8. The earthquake came amid ongoing rescue and recovery operations following floods triggered by an ice-rock avalanche near the Nepal-Tibet border on August 26. The disaster swept away homes, roads and bridges, damaged hydropower projects and left thousands missing. Authorities have also raised concerns over the region’s vulnerability to extreme weather, glacier retreat and rising temperatures. Chinese researchers have warned that climate change is accelerating glacier loss across the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, potentially increasing the risks of future disasters. The plateau is also the source of several major transboundary rivers, including the Brahmaputra, making environmental changes there a concern for downstream communities.
